description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class, specifically testing notification forwarding quiet hours configuration in an Android app. It uses Robolectric framework to run Android framework code in tests.

classes.name: SecurePrefsNotificationForwardingTest
classes.description: Test suite for notification forwarding quiet hours in SecurePrefs class

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_rejectsInvalidDraftsWithoutMutatingStoredValues
methods.description: Test that setting invalid quiet hours does not change stored preferences

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_persistsValidDraftsAndEnabledState
methods.description: Test that valid quiet hours are correctly persisted

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_disablesWithoutRevalidatingDrafts
methods.description: Test disabling quiet hours does not alter previous drafts

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy_readsLatestQuietHoursImmediately
methods.description: Test that the notification forwarding policy reflects latest quiet hours

methods.name: notificationForwarding_defaultsDisabledForSaferPosture
methods.description: Test default values for notification forwarding policy when no explicit settings are made
